::: {#exm-for-as-while}
#### The guard of a `for` loop

The guard (@def-loop-guard) of `root` (@exr-root-trace) is $(r + 1)^2 \le n$.

A `for` loop is a `while` loop written more briefly.
The loop on the left does the same thing as the loop on the right,
provided the body changes neither `i` nor `b`:

```text
for i := a to b              i := a
    body                     while i <= b
                                 body
                                 i := i + 1
```

So the guard of `for i := a to b` is $i \le b$,
and the loop stops at the first test where $i = b + 1$,
or at once if $a > b$.

:::
